name: Cosmos Daze, Wild Reverie

passive_description.localized: Increases wearer's damage dealt by <lv>{1}</> for <lv>{0}s</> after casting Support Skill. Triggers at most once every <lv>{2}s</>.
passive_description.source: 装备者释放「援护技」后<lv>{0}</>秒内，造成的伤害提高<lv>{1}</>。每<lv>{2}</>秒最多触发一次。

tested_hypotheses: Support Skill (QTE) admission triggers the 10-second All DMG bonus buff before same-time hits.
A 20-second per-wearer world-time internal cooldown governs triggering; casts during cooldown are admitted but neither grant the buff nor refresh existing duration.
Exact expiry precedes equal-time hits; exact cooldown readiness at 20 seconds permits a new buff grant.
The damage bonus buff is owned by the wearer and applies only to self packets; allies do not receive the bonus.
Off-field hits delivered by the wearer while switched out sample live buff state, retaining the bonus while active.
